scope: Physical SAR supplement; SOS and its frozen evidence remain primary and unchanged.
split_rule: Union all source groups sharing a polygon ID; assign each component to highest publisher held-out level: test > val > train. No random resplitting.
reason: OS03029GXS1 appears in IMG_17/test and IMG_18/train; differing acquisition dates/locations do not establish whether it is an ID collision or linked event.

physical_inputs.native_units: uint16 amplitude DN from original GRD TIFF
physical_inputs.calibration: sigma0 = DN^2 / sigmaNought_LUT^2, LUT interpolated on native line/pixel grid
physical_inputs.noise_limit: Both paired branches share uncorrected thermal noise; no claim of noise-corrected SNAP equivalence.
physical_inputs.geolocation: NumPy inverse bilinear geolocation, checked against SciPy; then sample linear power into publisher map grid.
physical_inputs.labels: Publisher mask > 0 (oil spill and natural seepage pooled); no oil-like negative cause labels.

registration.method: Same mean-subtracted Hann-window phase correlation as the two development tiles; upsample_factor=100; image only.
registration.reference: Publisher float TIFF used as an image alignment anchor, not as calibrated SAR input.
registration.transformation: Apply estimated row/column translation to all native physical channels consistently; never shift GT to maximize detection scores.

eligibility_checks_frozen_before_full_na.rationale: Engineering eligibility tolerances, not theoretical guarantees; 0.70 is looser than the observed 0.88-0.89 development correlations. Publish all exclusions and do not retune thresholds on test.
eligibility_checks_frozen_before_full_na.failure_behavior: Retain all failed-sample receipts and reasons; no silent fallback to PNG or other polarization. If scene-count gate fails, stop before model fitting.

boundary_handling: Restrict physical metrics and labels to a common interior crop of 8 map pixels on all sides for every paired branch; report crop and GT objects touching new boundary. No GT small-object removal.
exposure: All masks inspected by automated geometry audit; two IMG_01 train images inspected visually and used for registration development. Test is not claimed completely unseen.
model_protocol_status: Not yet frozen. Only source preparation and split are frozen here; model/grid selection must be specified and committed before fitting or scoring detection.
limits: Scene-group separation is not proof of independent spill events or meteorology.
Gamma conversion corrects a geometric area factor, not all ocean incidence-angle dependence.
Registration uses processed images; absolute geolocation and exporter processing history remain uncertain.
No model has been fitted or detection test score computed on this supplement.
